NOTIFICATION
Memo. No. 522/7017/CSSC/ESTT/2026 Dated: 07.03.2026
Sub: Debarring from appearing in the recruitment examination (for Group D staff)
scheduled on 08.03.26
It is notified for the information of all concerned that the candidates, whose names with
relevant details are attached below, are debarred from sitting for the written examination (for
the recruitment of Group D staff) scheduled on 08.03.26 for adopting unfair means and being
expelled from the Clerk recruitment examination held on 01.03.26. The admit cards for the
examination dated 08.03.26 of the said candidates are accordingly cancelled.
Sd/-
Chairman
West Bengal Central School Service Commission
